en: Hand‑colored postcard showing a busy street corner with a large three‑story building labeled as the concert and ball establishment "Deutsche Reichskrone". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand near the entrance; a tramcar marked with the number 7 travels along tracks on the left. Trees line the opposite side of the street. Printed captions identify the scene as part of Dresden, specifically Königslücker Straße and Bischofsweg. The style and printing suggest an early 1900s European urban scene.
